definition_en: to wish for something, to need something, to lack something, or a lack
core_image: 男孩站在橱窗前，盯着里面的玩具车

senses.title: To wish for something

senses.example: He does not want for money.
senses.why: The oldest sense keeps the plain idea of lacking.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项保留了缺少这一本义。

senses.title: A lack of something
senses.example: The plan failed for want of money.

definition_en: pleasantly hot, friendly, or to make something warm
core_image: 冬夜里，一家人围着小火炉取暖
scene: 冬夜里，一家人围着小火炉取暖On a winter night the family sits around a small stove to keep warm.

definition_en: to clean with water, to carry something away with water, or a single cleaning
core_image: 饭后，孩子站在水池前洗手
scene: 饭后，孩子站在水池前洗手After dinner the child stands at the sink and washes his hands.
sceneCN: 这里 wash 是「洗」（第 01 个义项）；句意是晚饭前洗手。

senses.title: To clean with water
senses.example: Wash your hands before dinner.
senses.why: Old English wascan named cleaning with water.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 wascan 指用水清洁。

senses.title: To clean clothes
senses.example: I need to wash these shirts.
senses.why: The same cleaning action applied to clothes became a common use.
senses.whyCN: 同样的清洁动作用在衣物上，便成常见用法。

senses.title: To carry away with water

senses.whyCN: 流水清洁表面时也把东西带走，动词便有了此义。

senses.title: A single cleaning
senses.example: Give the car a wash.
senses.why: The verb turned into a noun for one act of cleaning.
senses.whyCN: 动词转为名词，指一次清洗。

definition_en: to look at something for a time, a small clock worn on the wrist, to guard, or to be careful
core_image: 爷爷坐在树下，看着孩子们追着球跑
scene: 爷爷坐在树下，看着孩子们追着球跑Grandpa sits under the tree, watching the children run after the ball.
sceneCN: 这里 watch 是「观看」（第 01 个义项）；句意是我们在电视上看比赛。

senses.title: To look at something for a time
senses.definition: To look at something for a time
senses.example: We watched the game on TV.
senses.why: Old English wacan meant to be awake, and watching grew from staying alert.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 wacan 意为醒着，观看由保持警觉而来。

senses.title: A small clock worn on the wrist
senses.definition: A small clock worn on the wrist
senses.example: My watch stopped.
senses.why: A watch kept its wearer awake to time, and the name passed to the clock.
senses.whyCN: 表让人守着时间，名称便转给了这只小钟。

senses.title: To guard or take care of
senses.definition: To guard or take care of
senses.example: Watch the bags for a minute.
senses.why: Staying alert over things gives the sense of guarding.
senses.whyCN: 对东西保持警觉，便生看守之义。

senses.title: To be careful
senses.example: Watch out for the car.
senses.why: Alertness turns into a warning to be careful.
senses.whyCN: 警觉转为提醒人小心。
